class ApiTokenRevokeView(LoginRequiredMixin, DeleteView):
    model = ApiToken
    success_url = reverse_lazy('tokens:manage')
    pk_url_kwarg = 'token_id'
diagnosis: The DeleteView deletes an ApiToken by token_id extracted from the URL. Without restricting get_queryset() to user=self.request.user, any user can revoke third-party API credentials belonging to other developers or automated services.
